name: Call for Assistance During Student Altercation
description: Immediate call for help giving the exact location and nature of a student fight or altercation.

preparers.name: Employees who observe or learn of a fight or altercation

recipient: Building safety officer, climate and culture administrator, or principal / vice / assistant principal
quote: Immediately call for help by contacting the building safety officer, climate and culture administrator, building principal, vice principal, or assistant principal. Be prepared to indicate the exact location and the nature of the incident.
